construction.gap_rule_no_imputation: An industry enters a leg only after 252 valid daily returns. An industry-day with a missing return is dropped from that day's leg average and from that day's breadth, and is counted. No imputation, no substitute industry, no zero fill. Dropped industry-days are reported per window.
construction.legs: At each month-end t, beta of each eligible industry's daily returns to the French market (Mkt-RF+RF) over the 252 sessions ending t-1 (>= 200 valid pairs). OFFENCE = top third by beta, DEFENCE = bottom third (16 each with 49 industries; fewer before 1970), used for the following month. BASE = equal weight of all eligible industries, rebalanced monthly.

breadth_stand_ins.i: share of offence industries above their own 50-session SMA. Granularity 1/n_offence (about 1/16 = 6.25 pp); every grid threshold is a multiple of that step.
breadth_stand_ins.ii: narrowness: mean over offence industries of (equal-weighted minus value-weighted industry return over 60 sessions); continuous Descriptive only in both tiers.

construction.relative_line: cumulative offence-leg return over cumulative defence-leg return

H1.name: two-key switch vs the exposure-matched mix
H1.rule: Base = equal weight of eligible industries (NEUTRAL). Entry to DEFEND (defence leg): ARMED within the last 21 sessions (fixed arming memory) and the offence/defence relative line closes below its own 50-session SMA after closing at or above it. ARMED = relative line within h% of its 126-session high AND offence breadth (i) at least b below its 126-session maximum, both breadth values measured on the CURRENT leg's members (R2). Entry to ATTACK (offence leg), R12: a washout spell starts at the first close with offence breadth (i) <= 25% on the current leg's members and runs while closes stay <= 25%. The spell QUALIFIES only if, on at least one close inside the spell, the relative line is within h% of its own 126-session low: rel_t <= (1 + h/100) * min(rel over the 126 sessions ending at t, including t) - the literal mirror of the arming key's rel_t >= (1 - h/100) * max(rel over the same window). Same h as the grid point. ATTACK confirms on the first close above 25% if the spell qualifies AND that close is within 20 sessions of the spell's lowest breadth close (earliest if tied). Otherwise the spell ends with no ATTACK and the state in force continues under its own exit rule. Exits by state (R1): DEFEND ends at an ATTACK confirm (immediately) or at the first month-end on which the relative line closes above its own 50-session SMA, then NEUTRAL. ATTACK ends at a DEFEND trigger (immediately) or at the first month-end at least 63 sessions after entry, then NEUTRAL. A state is never exited on its entry day; a trigger on a month's last session stands and the month-end test first applies at the following month-end. Same-day DEFEND trigger and ATTACK confirm: DEFEND wins, counted. Re-triggering the state already in force is ignored and does not reset its clock. Decisions at close t, execution at close t+1, 10 bp per side.

declared_grid.selection: the setting with the highest 1998-2019 annualised excess over its matched mix, chosen after freeze on 1998-2019 only; exact ties (difference below 1e-9) go to the more conservative setting: smaller h first, then larger b. All 4 settings are counted. H2's control and the cash ablation inherit the selected point.

H1.arming_check_1998_2019: Rerun under rev 4 (signals table). The earlier 7.6-19.7% were WITHOUT the 21-session memory and with a stitched breadth maximum; under R2 without memory they are 7.6-19.7% again, and WITH the memory the armed share is 26.9-47.7% (price-only 52.6-65.3%).
H1.primary_contrast: annualised mean daily return of H1 minus the exposure-matched static mix of offence, defence and base at H1's average weights, rebuilt inside every bootstrap resample from that resample's own average weights (parent ruling A)
H1.differs_from_run_B_R7: R7 is prior negative evidence against H1's breadth key. H1 differs in two ways: (1) a second key is required - the offence/defence relative line must break its 50-session SMA after arming; R7 switched on the breadth drop alone; (2) legs are beta-sorted thirds re-formed monthly from data to t-1, not R7's fixed named cyclical and defensive groups; H1 also starts from equal weight, not from the cyclical leg.

fixed_settings.washout_clock: from the spell's lowest close (earliest if tied)

breadth_rules.R2_current_leg: each day the 126-session breadth history (arming key and washout spell) is recomputed on the current leg's members over the look-back; never a stitched series of past legs. The relative line remains a chained return series.
breadth_rules.R5_share: b is compared as a share of the leg's eligible industries. Step about 6.25 points with 16 offence members (from 1970); about 7-8 points before 1970 (13-14 members).

H1.plain_description: Under R12, on 1998-2019 industry portfolios: 179 breadth washout spells (about eight a year, median 3 sessions); 97 qualify at h=3 and 112 at h=5 (relative line near its 126-session low inside the spell); 83 (h=3) and 98 (h=5) fire ATTACK confirms, about 3.8-4.5 a year - more than one every two years at both h, so the ATTACK leg is exercised. ATTACK entries 1.5-1.8 a year (confirms while ATTACK is already held are ignored), held 37-39% of sessions with a median spell of 69-72 sessions; DEFEND entries 1.7-2.7 a year, held 18-25% of sessions with a median spell of 18-22 sessions; NEUTRAL 38-43%. DEFEND ends mostly at a month-end with the relative line back above its SMA (29-36 exits) rather than by an ATTACK confirm (9-23 exits); ATTACK ends mostly at the 63-session month-end (21-25) rather than by a DEFEND trigger (7-18). Same-day conflicts: 0. H1 is a three-state rule with roughly comparable time in each state, not a mostly-offence tilt. These counts were seen before freeze; no threshold, grid point or window was changed because of them.
H1.mirror_note: Mirror choice: 'within h% of the high' is coded rel >= (1 - h/100) * high, so 'within h% of the low' is rel <= (1 + h/100) * low. The alternative rel <= low / (1 - h/100) was not used; it was not evaluated or counted.

H2.name: breadth in the arming key adds information (the washout breadth is in both arms)
H2.rule: H1 minus the identical rule with the breadth condition removed from ARMED only; the ATTACK rule (breadth washout plus relative-line-near-low qualification) is identical in both arms; exits and fixed settings identical; same h as selected. Paired daily difference.
H2.primary_contrast: annualised mean of the paired daily difference H1 - H1_price_only
H2.inherits: H2's price-only control and the cash ablation use exactly the H1 grid point selected on 1998-2019; no second selection is made for any derived book.

H3.name: simplest direct control: 126-day relative momentum between the legs (run B R5 on beta-sorted legs)
H3.rule: At each month-end hold the offence leg if its 126-session return exceeds the defence leg's, else the defence leg. No parameters beyond 126.
H3.primary_contrast: vs its exposure-matched static mix, rebuilt inside each resample
H3.why: Parent ruling 12:05Z; trend-and-Sahm with defensives (SI's suggestion) is run B R6's near twin and showed no benefit. I have no better-motivated candidate.

hypotheses.mandatory_ablation: H1 with cash in place of the defence leg (identical DEFEND dates, bills instead of defensives); reported, not tested Inherits H1's selected grid point; no second selection.
hypotheses.descriptive_state_split: H1's excess over the matched mix split by state held (DEFEND, ATTACK, NEUTRAL days); reported, no extra trial.
